texts: Each cauldron yields a vessel that is partly full of mire-essence.

fields.sentence: Each cauldron yields a vessel that is partly full of mire-essence.
parse: (: cauldron_yield_rule (Implication (Member $x cauldron) (And (Member (sk_yield $x) yield) (Agent (sk_yield $x) $x) (Patient (sk_yield $x) (sk_vessel $x)) (Member (sk_vessel $x) vessel) (Member (sk_full $x) full) (Experiencer (sk_full $x) (sk_vessel $x)) (Of (sk_full $x) mire_essence) (Degree (sk_vessel $x) full partly) (Member (sk_vessel $x) full))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q1_issues.issue: The flat dual-emit conjunct (Member (sk_vessel $x) full) asserts outright that the vessel is full, which 'partly full' does not license — the hedge survives only in the Degree atom, so the unqualified half widens the claim.

q2_gaps: partial-extent degree modifiers on an adjective ('partly', 'half', 'mostly'): the carve-out that suppresses the flat positive is stated only for approximators 'almost / nearly / all but', and the Degree bullet keeps the positive on the stated rationale that intensifiers entail the property — neither branch covers a modifier that entails the property does NOT hold in full
review.notes: Everything else matches the instruction set: 'each' gives the distributing rule at 1.0/0.9 with its QuantifierPhrase companion, the relative clause takes the adjective-PP-complement reification (state witness + Experiencer + Of), and mire_essence gets its head-noun genus with the noun modifier unexposed.

issues.reason: "Partly full" entails the vessel is NOT full, so the flat conjunct (Member (sk_vessel $x) full) asserts more than the text states; the Degree bullet keeps the positive only on the stated rationale that intensifiers entail the property, and the instruction set's own handling of a cancelling modifier ("the tank was almost full") reifies the state WITHOUT its flat half.

gaps_confirmed: partial-extent modifiers on an adjective ("partly / half / mostly"): the flat-positive suppression is stated only for the approximators "almost / nearly / all but", and the Degree bullet keeps the positive on an entailment rationale, so neither branch covers a modifier that entails the property does not hold in full
adjudication.defect_summary: The compliant form drops the flat (Member (sk_vessel $x) full) and keeps the reified state with its Of complement plus (Degree (sk_vessel $x) full partly), on the approximator treatment "reify the state without its flat half"; nothing else in the parse changes.
adjudication.notes: Everything else conforms: "each" gives the distributing rule at 1.0/0.9 with its QuantifierPhrase companion, the per-cauldron vessel is a correct dependent Skolem term, the relative clause takes the adjective-PP-complement reification, and mire_essence gets its head genus with the noun modifier unexposed.
